⚠️ The review verdict is **fix**: all eight screenshots show Chrome's "This site can't be reached" page, so nobody has seen the InstanceTree page actually render. The private server on port 60833 was down when the shots were taken, so they need retaking with it running.

The other two fixes:
- **No side-by-side view:** the demo page puts the tree under the buttons in one column, not beside the demo as asked.
- **Links in the wrong place:** the "live tree" links went into the System and catalog readmes, not onto their class cards.

The full report is at `instance-tree/review/report.md`.
